description: Shared cross-boundary contract fixture for the ACP session activity report. The vm-agent SERIALIZES this shape (packages/vm-agent/internal/acp/session_host_reporting.go:activityPayload) and the Worker VALIDATES it (apps/api/src/schemas/acp-sessions.ts:AcpSessionActivityReportSchema). Both sides consume this same file so a rename on either side fails a test instead of silently dropping the field at runtime. See .claude/rules/23-cross-boundary-contract-tests.md.

cases.name: harness_work_active
cases.comment: Full harness-background-work report: the payload that defers session sleep.

cases.name: harness_work_settling
cases.comment: One-shot finite settling lease emitted when the active set drains.

cases.name: harness_work_inactive
cases.comment: Explicit inactive publish on process detach.

cases.name: legacy_no_harness_fields
cases.comment: Backward compatibility: an older vm-agent with no harness support omits every runtimeWork* field. Must still validate.
